item.title: 【Requests】Filled - [REQ] Britney Spears - Slumber Party (Solo Version) [24bit]
item.description:
I am having a hell of a time finding this song specifically in 24bit, since there's literally very little change in the times and I can't fathom going through 100s of downloads on Soulseek to find the correct one when it's labeled wrong. Does anyone have the SOLO version in 24bit? If it doesn't exist, I'll even take a CD rip in 16bit but I would prefer 24bit, thank you! For reference, this was only available for a little while it's so harder to find solo. If anyone knows downloads on here that have the correct solo version too, let me know the thread and I'll just download it there too. Thanks!
